bound: The family is the ten-plus wave directories under results/trial_labor_w*/; a merged key is only counted when two or more of those directories hold a file of that basename.  The reader census sees path literals in in-repo .py files, so a reader that builds the name at runtime is invisible here; a constant_dir row is published unresolved because the constant may be wave-scoped in its own module.  Nothing here rewrites a wave's prep/judge state.

summary.reader_class_rule: a literal basename is a label when it sits in a tuple/list/dict beside a Name (the path is the Name); wave_expr when the enclosing join's other argument, or the same line before the literal, carries a wave token; wave_scoped_constant when the joined Name resolves to an assignment carrying a wave token; constant_dir_unresolved otherwise; bare_key only when none of those hold
